title: Folio MCP 与原生 pi：隔离对照测试
sourceWorkingTree: Product src unchanged; benchmark harness updated for isolation and review.

protocol.inputTokens: Provider-reported cumulative input + cacheRead + cacheWrite over all calls; recorded failure usage included. In-flight requests without returned usage cannot be measured.
protocol.outputTokens: Provider-reported cumulative output; token counts are not currency costs.
protocol.verdict: Manual review against source; safe scan abstention reported separately from accomplishing the requested identification. Write integrity ignores only trailing newlines and optional blank lines immediately before the inserted Markdown paragraph.
protocol.sharedTools: Both arms retain native read/bash/edit/write and installed Python/PyMuPDF/RapidOCR. Folio itself does not provide OCR.
protocol.limitations: Six synthetic tasks targeting PDF/Markdown/CSV, three repeats; descriptive sample, no statistical significance claim. Same Windows OS tools, not an OS sandbox. Indexing time shown separately.

isolation.description: Per attempt: separate PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, HOME/USERPROFILE, APPDATA, caches, temp and npm config. Sessions/context/skills/templates disabled. Fresh homes have no personal extensions; built-in extensions remain enabled because pi implements MCP as one. Configuration isolation, not an OS filesystem sandbox. Both arms also load the same pi-isolation-guard.mjs to remap literal /tmp and block pi paths/file-tool escapes.

excludedPilot: Two preflights were stopped: --no-extensions disables pi's built-in MCP, and environment variables alone do not remap hard-coded /tmp paths. Both excluded preflights are retained under tests/tmp; formal runs apply the same tool-input guard to both arms.

nativeTextProbe.note: Independent read-only PyMuPDF probe confirmed the locating PDF has usable text; agent console-decoding failures do not mean the PDF requires OCR.
